scientific_integrity: The seven-rung exhaustive certificate verifies every local state, not a sample. Its full-size implication uses graph-distance-three locality and a separate local trigger incompatibility argument. Exact counts arise from a constructively specified finite automaton.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic three-state, two-excited-neighbor rule on open two-row ladders only; the exact local truth table is finite and exhaustively checked, with a causal locality argument extending it to all lengths. No minimum-state automaton, sharp probability decay constant, or independent validation is asserted; unindexed equivalent prior results remain possible.
title: A seven-rung causal trigger and sharp five-update extinction on open ladders
